title: Decoding the Black Box: Discerning AI Rhetorics About and Through Poetic Prompting

bias_targets.methodology: Using Poetic Prompt Patterns to ask LLMs to describe, analyze, and adapt the poetry of a Black writer (Maya Angelou), then applying Critical Discourse Analysis to identify tokenization, positive-to-neutral racial stereotyping, and the dilution of the specific 'Black experience' in favor of universal themes.

Evaluating model responses to requests to rewrite culturally significant poetry for new presumed audiences, examining the models' willingness to appropriate style and voice, and analyzing their explanations for cultural respect versus appropriation.

Prompting models to explore a Black woman poet's intersectional feminist approach and applying Critical Discourse Analysis to observe how the models articulate themes of women's empowerment and gender-based conflicts.
